name: Google Antigravity
description: Builds and runs coding agents for developers across a desktop agent manager, an agentic IDE, a terminal CLI, and a Python SDK on Google's Antigravity harness.

skills.name: Parallel Agent Manager
skills.description: Runs multiple local agents in parallel from the desktop app, grouped into projects across several workspaces.

skills.name: Scheduled Tasks
skills.description: Automates routine work with scheduled messages, also available as the /schedule command.

skills.name: Background Subagents
skills.description: Spawns and manages background subagents from the terminal CLI while running shell commands directly.

skills.name: Browser-in-the-Loop
skills.description: Drives a browser during tasks to automate repetitive UX work, with browser recordings and allow and deny lists.

skills.name: Custom Agent SDK
skills.description: Builds custom Python agents on the Antigravity harness with custom tools, MCP servers, skills, hooks, and streamed output.
